contexts.text: No one esteems the expressions of anyone...
In the Spiritual World everyone is estimated according to the good and truth... in which he is; (as on earth) everyone is estimated for his wealth and his favour with his chief. HH 407.
Can speak with any others whom they have esteemed and revered.
Such as is the animus and mind, such is the estimation of all things which come forth through the external.
Many things which are of slight value... are most highly valued by the Angels... And those things which are most highly valued by man... are of slight value to the Angels...
A shekel = the price or estimation of good and truth.
A full state of what is estimated as to good. Signified.
Everyone esteems and loves his own.

In the Heavens... as everyone loves, esteems, and honours a use, so he loves, esteems, and honours the person to whom that use is adjoined; and the person, too, is so far loved, esteemed, and honoured, as he does not ascribe the use to himself... Spiritual love, esteem, and honour are nothing but the love, esteem, and honour of use in the person...
Abraham, etc., are there held in no higher estimation than others.
The estimation of good and truth, such as it exists with them. Signified. AR 315. AE 373, Explained. AE 374.
Every created thing is esteemed according to its internal goodness...
Imputation itself corresponds to the estimation and price.
As everyone is estimated according to his interiors...
According to virtues and their estimations.
The spiritual have reverence and esteem...
